newsitem.title: CHINA: HK property deals value up 145 pct yr-on-yr in H1.
newsitem.headline: HK property deals value up 145 pct yr-on-yr in H1.

text.p: Hong Kong recorded 115,673 sale and purchase agreements worth $483.58 billion in the first half of 1997 for residential and non-residential properties, the government Land Registry said on Sunday.
The value of agreements rose 74.2 percent on the second half of 1996, and 145.3 percent year-on-year.
The number of deals increased 44.6 percent on the preceeding half-year and 71.5 percent on the first six months of 1996.

During the first half of this year, the value of assignments of building units lodged for registration stood at HK$378.04 billion, up 66.5 percent on the preceding six months and 103.9 percent year-on-year.
The total amount secured under mortgages, other than building mortgages, was HK$43.71 billion, an increase of 28.4 percent versus the second half of 1996, and six percent year-on-year.
In June, Hong Kong recorded 17,510 sale and purchase agreements worth HK$81.4 billion for residential and non-residential properties.
The value was up 17.4 per cent on May, and 134.1 percent year-on-year.
The number of deals in June fell 11.4 per cent from the preceding month but rose 58.4 percent year-on-year.
